readings.title: My Ěl, Why Have You Forsaken Me?
readings.subtitle: The Mockery of Men
readings.text:
[Psalm 22:1] <dn>My</dn> <dn>Ěl</dn>, <dn>My</dn> <dn>Ěl</dn>, why have <dn>You</dn> forsaken <dn>Me</dn> – Far from saving <dn>Me</dn>, far from the words of <dn>My</dn> groaning?
[2] O <dn>My</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>I</dn> call by day, but <dn>You</dn> do not answer; And by night, but <dn>I</dn> find no rest.
[3] Yet <dn>You</dn> are set-apart, Enthroned on the praises of Yisra’ěl.
[4] Our fathers trusted in <dn>You</dn>; They trusted, and <dn>You</dn> delivered them.
[5] They cried to <dn>You</dn>, and were delivered; They trusted in <dn>You</dn>, and were not ashamed.
[6] But <dn>I</dn> am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised by the people.
[7] All those who see <dn>Me</dn> mock <dn>Me</dn>; They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
[8] “He trusted in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, let <dn>Him</dn> rescue <dn>Him</dn>; Let <dn>Him</dn> deliver <dn>Him</dn>, seeing <dn>He</dn> has delighted in <dn>Him</dn>!”
[9] For <dn>You</dn> are the One who took <dn>Me</dn> out of the womb; Causing <dn>Me</dn> to trust while on <dn>My</dn> mother’s breasts.
[10] <dn>I</dn> was cast upon <dn>You</dn> from birth. From <dn>My</dn> mother’s belly <dn>You</dn> have been <dn>My</dn> <dn>Ěl</dn>.

readings.title: Poured Out Like Water
readings.subtitle: Deliver My Life from the Sword
readings.text:
[Psalm 22:11] Do not be far from <dn>Me</dn>, For distress is near; For there is none to help.
[12] Many bulls have surrounded <dn>Me</dn>; Strong ones of Bashan have encircled <dn>Me</dn>.
[13] They have opened their mouths against <dn>Me</dn>, As a raging and roaring lion.
[14] <dn>I</dn> have been poured out like water, And all <dn>My</dn> bones have been spread apart; <dn>My</dn> heart has become like wax; It has melted in the midst of <dn>My</dn> inward parts.
[15] <dn>My</dn> strength is dried like a potsherd, And <dn>My</dn> tongue is cleaving to <dn>My</dn> jaws; And to the dust of death <dn>You</dn> are appointing <dn>Me</dn>.
[16] For dogs have surrounded <dn>Me</dn>; A crowd of evil ones have encircled <dn>Me</dn>, Piercing <dn>My</dn> hands and <dn>My</dn> feet;
[17] <dn>I</dn> count all <dn>My</dn> bones. They look, they stare at <dn>Me</dn>.
[18] They divide <dn>My</dn> garments among them, And for <dn>My</dn> raiment they cast lots.
[19] But <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, do not be far off; O <dn>My</dn> Strength, hasten to help <dn>Me</dn>!
[20] Deliver <dn>My</dn> life from the sword, <dn>My</dn> only life from the power of the dog.
[21] Save <dn>Me</dn> from the mouth of the lion, And from the horns of the wild beasts! <dn>You</dn> have answered <dn>Me</dn>.

readings.title: Praise in the Great Assembly
readings.subtitle: A Seed Shall Serve Him
readings.text:
[Psalm 22:22] <dn>I</dn> make known <dn>Your</dn> Name to <dn>My</dn> brothers; In the midst of the assembly <dn>I</dn> praise <dn>You</dn>.
[23] You who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, praise <dn>Him</dn>! All you seed of Ya‛aqoḇ, esteem <dn>Him</dn>, And fear <dn>Him</dn>, all you seed of Yisra’ěl!
[24] For <dn>He</dn> has not despised Nor hated the affliction of the afflicted; Nor has <dn>He</dn> hidden <dn>His</dn> face from <dn>Him</dn>; But when <dn>He</dn> cried to <dn>Him</dn>, <dn>He</dn> heard.
[25] From <dn>You</dn> is <dn>My</dn> praise in the great assembly; <dn>I</dn> pay <dn>My</dn> vows before those who fear <dn>Him</dn>.
[26] The meek ones do eat and are satisfied; Let those who seek <dn>Him</dn> praise <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. Let your heart live forever!
[27] Let all the ends of the earth Remember and turn to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And all clans of the nations Bow themselves before <dn>You</dn>.
[28] For the reign belongs to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>He</dn> is ruling over the nations.
[29] All the fat ones of the earth Shall eat and bow themselves; All who go down to the dust bow before <dn>Him</dn>, Even he who did not keep alive his own life.
[30] A seed shall serve <dn>Him</dn>. It is declared of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to the coming generation.
[31] They shall come and declare <dn>His</dn> righteousness To a people yet to be born, For <dn>He</dn> shall do it!

readings.title: YeHoVaH is My Shepherd
readings.subtitle: My Cup Runs Over
readings.text:
[Psalm 23:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is my shepherd; I do not lack.
[2] <dn>He</dn> makes me to lie down in green pastures; <dn>He</dn> leads me beside still waters.
[3] <dn>He</dn> turns back my being; <dn>He</dn> leads me in paths of righteousness For <dn>His</dn> Name’s sake.
[4] When I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I fear no evil. For <dn>You</dn> are with me; <dn>Your</dn> rod and <dn>Your</dn> staff, they comfort me.
[5] <dn>You</dn> spread before me a table in the face of my enemies; <dn>You</dn> have anointed my head with oil; My cup runs over.
[6] Only goodness and loving-commitment follow me All the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, To the length of days!

readings.title: The Earth Belongs to YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Lift Up Your Heads, O Gates
readings.text:
[Psalm 24:1] The earth belongs to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And all that fills it – The world and those who dwell in it.
[2] For <dn>He</dn> has founded it upon the seas, And upon the waters <dn>He</dn> does establish it.
[3] Who does go up into the mountain of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? And who does stand in <dn>His</dn> set-apart place?
[4] He who has innocent hands and a clean heart, Who did not bring his life to naught, And did not swear deceivingly.
[5] He receives a blessing from <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And righteousness from the <dn>Elohim</dn> of his deliverance.
[6] This is the generation of those who seek <dn>Him</dn>; Ya‛aqoḇ, who seek <dn>Your</dn> face. Selah.
[7] Lift up your heads, O you gates! And be lifted up, you everlasting doors! And let the Sovereign of esteem come in.
[8] Who is this Sovereign of esteem? <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> strong and mighty, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> mighty in battle.
[9] Lift up your heads, O you gates! Even lift up, you everlasting doors! And let the Sovereign of esteem come in.
[10] Who is this Sovereign of esteem? <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dn>He</dn> is the Sovereign of esteem! Selah.

readings.title: Show Me Your Ways
readings.subtitle: Remember Your Compassion
readings.text:
[Psalm 25:1] Aleph To <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, I lift up my being.
[2] Bět O my <dn>Elohim</dn>, in <dn>You</dn> I have put my trust; Let me not be ashamed; Let not my enemies exult over me.
[3] Gimel Indeed, let no one who waits on <dn>You</dn> be ashamed; Let those who are treacherous without cause be ashamed.
[4] Dalet Show me <dn>Your</dn> ways, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Teach me <dn>Your</dn> paths.
[5] Hě Lead me in <dn>Your</dn> truth (Waw) and teach me, For <dn>You</dn> are the <dn>Elohim</dn> of my deliverance; On <dn>You</dn> I wait all the day.
[6] Zayin Remember, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> compassion and <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitments, For they are from everlasting.
[7] Ḥet Do not remember the sins of my youth, and my transgressions; According to <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment remember me, For <dn>Your</dn> goodness’ sake, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[8] Tet Good and straight is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Therefore <dn>He</dn> teaches sinners in the way.
[9] Yod <dn>He</dn> guides the meek ones in right-ruling, And <dn>He</dn> teaches the meek ones <dn>His</dn> way.
[10] Kaph All the paths of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> are loving-commitment and truth, To those who guard <dn>His</dn> covenant and <dn>His</dn> witnesses.
[11] Lamed For <dn>Your</dn> Name’s sake, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> shall pardon my crookedness, though it is great.

readings.title: The Man That Fears YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Redeem Yisra’ěl
readings.text:
[Psalm 25:12] Mem Who, then, is the man that fears <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? <dn>He</dn> teaches him in the way he should choose.
[13] Nun His life dwells in good, And his seed inherits the earth.
[14] Sameḵ The secret of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is with those who fear <dn>Him</dn>, And <dn>He</dn> makes <dn>His</dn> covenant known to them.
[15] Ayin My eyes are ever toward <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For <dn>He</dn> brings my feet out of the net.
[16] Pě Turn <dn>Your</dn> face to me, and show me favour, For I am lonely and afflicted.
[17] Tsadi The distresses of my heart have enlarged; Oh, bring me out of my distresses!
[18] Rěsh Look on my affliction and my toil, And forgive all my sins.
[19] Rěsh See how many my enemies have become; And they hate me with a violent hatred.
[20] Shin Oh, guard my life, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in <dn>You</dn>.
[21] Tav Let integrity and straightness guard me, For I have waited for <dn>You</dn>.
[22] Redeem <dn>את</dn> Yisra’ěl, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, Out of all his distresses!

readings.title: Examine Me and Prove Me
readings.subtitle: I Walk in My Integrity
readings.text:
[Psalm 26:1] Rule me rightly, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For I have walked in my integrity. And I have trusted in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, without wavering.
[2] Examine me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and prove me; Try my kidneys and my heart.
[3] For <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment is before my eyes, And I have walked in <dn>Your</dn> truth.
[4] I have not sat with men of falsehood, Nor do I enter with pretenders.
[5] I have hated the assembly of evil-doers, And I do not sit with the wrong.
[6] I wash my hands in innocence; And I walk around <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> slaughter-place, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,
[7] To raise a voice of thanksgiving, And to declare all <dn>Your</dn> wonders.
[8] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, I have loved the abode of <dn>Your</dn> house, And the place where <dn>Your</dn> esteem dwells.
[9] Do not gather my being together with sinners, Nor my life with bloodthirsty men,
[10] In whose hands is a plot, And their right hand is filled with bribes.
[11] But as for me, I walk in my integrity; Redeem me and show me favour.
[12] My foot shall stand on a level place; In the assemblies I bless <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
